items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Claude is in Creole, it's Claude, but it's a hard lump of date, see, but in Creole that's Claude.

ctx.x: Like on grass, you mean? No.

They have floors or something? No, no floors. They were scraped what they call... Claude. Claude. Claude is in Creole, it's Claude, but it's a hard lump of date, see, but in Creole that's Claude. I see. I know. And they would get like a rake and scrape all that off. They'd get it smooth. What did they dance there? Dance on that? Just on the ground. On the ground, yeah. And all the hard pebbles, you know, that's what we call Claude's back in those days.
I see. You mean this is where out in the country?
